courseName.description: The course as displayed and addressed — the derived code (STAT 240) where the source carried one. Also the folder's last path component.

courseFolder.description: Root-relative, forward-slashed, so it can be compared directly to a note listing's folder.

courseNoteCount.description: How many notes the folder holds. Zero is a real answer: a course can exist and be empty.

courseUpdated.description: ISO-8601 of the most recently changed note in the course, absent when it holds none.

courseRoot.description: The root-relative school folder the courses were read from, so a caller can say where they came from without knowing the convention.
